summary: Convert a proven JavaScript string to a Unicode scalar value string by replacing unpaired UTF-16 surrogates.

requirements.argument: proven JavaScript String; general ToString coercion owned by COERCION

target.notes: Reuse string/coercion ownership for obtaining the input string; this helper only performs USVString surrogate repair.

semantics.valid_surrogate_pairs: preserved as the corresponding scalar value

caveats: Do not iterate C# chars and replace every surrogate independently; valid pairs must remain paired.
